A LITTLE GUIDANCE

Let your thoughts branch.

Click a card and start writing. Click outside it to see your Markdown come to life.

↓ Same column
Add the next thought with the + below a card. The + on a vertical line makes room in between.
→ Next column
Use the + to the right of a card to add its first child. Add more children with the + above or below that child.
↔ Fold a branch
Hover the line leaving a card to the right, then click to hide its children. Click the little square to expand them again. Hidden writing is still saved and exported.
⇤ Merge cards
Option/Alt + Ctrl + Shift + arrows merges with a neighbor. ↑ / ↓ requires the same parent: the upper card stays, followed by both sets of children in order. ← merges into the parent; → merges its first child (expand folded branches first). The parent stays; the selected child’s children take its place and move left. Other siblings keep their order. Text stays in top-to-bottom or parent-first order, separated by a paragraph. Nested folds are preserved. Undo restores the original cards and children.
↕ Make room
Drag the top handle within or between columns. Drop above/below a card, or beside a parent to attach as its child. The whole branch travels with it. Escape cancels a drag.
↳ Open a draft
Open accepts Cardamomo documents and Markdown files. Cardamomo documents restore cards, connections, folds, zoom, and canvas position. Markdown headings become columns. New starts with one blank card. Undo restores the previous draft.
⛶ Full focus
The focus button beside dark mode fills the screen and hides the header. Use it again or press Escape to leave. Opening a card to write brings its column to the center.
↗ Take it with you
Save keeps your complete document as a .cardamomo file for continuing on another device. Export creates plain Markdown, reading a card, its children, then the next sibling.

Option/Alt + Ctrl + Shift + arrows merges cards · Undo restores the tree
Option/Alt + Ctrl + arrows opens a card to write: ↑ / ↓ same column, ← parent, → first child
Ctrl + Shift + → adds a first child · Ctrl + Shift + ↑ / ↓ adds above/below
⌘/Ctrl S saves a Cardamomo document
⌘/Ctrl Enter splits a card at the cursor
Enter starts a paragraph · Shift + Enter adds a line break
⌘/Ctrl B toggles bold · ⌘/Ctrl I toggles italic · text stays selected
⌘/Ctrl E cycles selected text: lowercase → ALL CAPS → Sentence case → Word Case
Esc exits focus mode or finishes editing · ⌘/Ctrl Z undoes a change
Alt + ↑ / ↓ moves a focused card
